name: logo-com
description: Browse your LOGO.com logos and create new logo designs from a chat. Requires a LOGO.com premium plan.

interface.longDescription:
Connect your LOGO.com account to look through your logos and create new logo designs from a chat.

List your most recent logos with previews and editor links, open one to see its colors, fonts and download files, or describe your business and get up to four new designs. New designs are drafts until you open one in the LOGO.com editor and save it.

Requirements: a LOGO.com premium plan. Creating designs uses your account's AI credits.
